target.output: host-facing live worker allocation snapshot bridge

problem: Landed role-fluid allocator, dynamic-readiness and Control Room projection are not directly consumed or projected by the /wc bootstrap; fresh workers still reconstruct the five-queue frontier through many remote reads and repeated lost claim races under a saturated wave.
acceptance: a fresh /wc worker can obtain one bounded current compatible-frontier projection covering all five active queues, claim occupancy, derived readiness, recovery and role candidates
the projection carries exact source head/epoch/input receipts and fails closed when stale or drifted
allocator output matches a direct full-scan reference fixture for prepared, derived-ready, claimed and recovery cases
after a lost atomic claim race the worker can refresh bounded occupancy/frontier deltas instead of repeating full queue archaeology
atomic create-if-absent claim remains the only reservation authority and the projection cannot promote Current, Human Accepted or Served
title: Host-facing /wc allocation snapshot bridge
mission: Wire the landed universal-worker allocator, dependency-derived readiness compiler and Control Room projection into one bounded current allocation snapshot that /wc can consume before individual claim CAS attempts. Preserve exact live-head/epoch/input receipts, fail closed on drift, prove parity against direct full-scan allocation and keep create-if-absent claim files as the sole reservation authority.

human_friction_reduction.reason: Fresh workers can consume one bounded allocation projection instead of repeatedly reconstructing all queue and occupancy state through many remote reads.

unblock_value.reason: This makes the already-landed allocator, readiness and Control Room mechanisms directly useful at bootstrap under high worker concurrency rather than leaving them as separate candidate tools.

regression_prevention.reason: Pinned-head parity and fail-closed drift tests prevent a convenience projection from becoming stale reservation truth or authority.

fail_if: snapshot and direct full-scan allocator disagree on compatible prepared/derived-ready occupancy under the same pinned source head
a stale or drifted snapshot permits a worker to treat an occupied opportunity as safely claimable without revalidation
the snapshot is treated as reservation authority instead of advisory projection before atomic claim creation
the bridge drops recovery eligibility, dependency failures, authority blockers or source receipts
the bridge promotes Current, Human Accepted or Served state
falsification.pass_if: Under a pinned repository head, the bounded snapshot is parity-equivalent to direct allocation for prepared, derived-ready, claimed and recovery cases; drift fails closed; a lost claim triggers bounded refresh; and exclusive claim creation remains the only reservation authority.
